reproduction.server_package: The tested executable comes with its upstream llmd.runfiles directory in the 20260924.0-cuda distribution.

separate_gpu_graph_profile.method: CUPTI kernel activity is matched to each cuGraphLaunch within a marked request. Each measured request has one full wide prefill graph. The span runs from the first GPU kernel start to the last GPU kernel end of that graph. Decode uses the median span of complete single-token decode graphs. The figures exclude CPU and network time; overlapping kernel durations may sum to more than the span.

guarded_bf16_tiles.comparison: Separate cold compilation caches, default XLA autotuning, same official executable, checkpoint and physical V100. Both modes disable MTP. GPU graph phases and server counters come from separate runs.

guarded_bf16_tiles.numerics: FP32 accumulation can round differently on the Volta FP16 tensor-core path. On the representable rounding test, 50 of 512 outputs per warp changed bits and the maximum absolute error against the double-precision reference was 3.82e-6. Ineligible input cases used the scalar path. Independently autotuned baseline runs also differed in wording.
